target.statement: ANOVA eta-squared for gap-closing rate (v_rel) discriminating K=3 clusters of hard-braking events at -0.5 m/s2 threshold: eta2 = 0.715

compute.basis: NGSIM is freely downloadable (~1-2 GB) and the pipeline (filtering, feature extraction, K-means with 50 restarts, ANOVA) is small classic ML on ~500 events, but no code is released so the entire preprocessing/event-detection/clustering pipeline must be reimplemented from prose, and exact reproduction of the 0.715 value depends on undocumented details (chunking, imputation, cluster init).

blockers: No code or configs released; full pipeline must be reimplemented from text
NGSIM has documented measurement errors and requires careful filtering to match the 1,060,119-observation count
Exact eta2 depends on K-means initialization/restarts and imputation choices not fully specified
title: Kinematic Discriminants of Deceleration Behavior Modes in Car-Following: Evidence from NGSIM Trajectory Data
